steps.clueRiddle:
A star-shaped fort guards the top of the cliff.
At noon it makes the loudest bang in town.
steps.clueReveal: Who's brave enough for the cannon? Watch the band, then tour the Citadelle. Cover your ears at noon!

challenges.title: Stand Like a Soldier
challenges.instructions: Watch the Royal 22e Régiment band play. Stand up straight like a guard. No smiling!

challenges.title: Gather the Fort Intel
challenges.instructions: Listen closely on the tour. The guide says every answer. Then take the quiz.

trivia.q: What animal is the regiment's mascot?
trivia.funFact: The mascot goat is always named Batisse. He marches with the soldiers.

trivia.q: What shape is the Citadelle built in?
trivia.funFact: Star-shaped forts let soldiers watch every side at once.

trivia.q: What happens at the Citadelle every day at noon?
trivia.funFact: The noon cannon is very loud. Ears covered!
Workers built it slowly, from 1820 all the way to 1850.

steps.funFact: The Citadelle is still a real army home for the Royal 22e Régiment.

steps.clueRiddle:
A huge grassy field where two armies once met.
Today the only battle is you versus the clock.
steps.clueReveal: Walk onto the Plains of Abraham. Sprint to a monument and back.

challenges.title: Battlefield Sprint
challenges.instructions: Pick a monument you can see. Race there and run back. Beat ninety seconds!

steps.funFact: A famous battle happened on this field in 1759. Now it's a park.

steps.clueRiddle:
A museum that says yes, please touch.
Inside are things older than your great-grandparents.
steps.clueReveal: Drive down to the Musée de la civilisation. Try the hands-on exhibits.

challenges.title: Hands-On Hunt
challenges.instructions: Explore the museum room by room. Tick off each mission you finish.
checklist: Find something that came off a boat

steps.funFact: A stone house from 1752 is built right into this museum.

steps.clueRiddle:
Books now sleep where prisoners once did.
Find four clues to unlock your escape.
steps.clueReveal: Walk up to the Morrin Centre. It is a library inside an old prison.

challenges.title: Prison Break
challenges.instructions: Find all four clues inside the old jail. The last tick unlocks your escape.

steps.funFact: This building was a prison, then a college, and now a library.

steps.clueRiddle:
A cabin in the city where maple runs like rain.
Bring your appetite and your judging face.
steps.clueReveal: Have dinner at Restaurant La Buche. Taste two things and rate them.

challenges.title: Judge's Table: Main Dish
challenges.instructions: Order tourtière or shepherd's pie. Taste it slowly. Give it your maple leaf rating.
challenges.photoPrompt: Snap a picture of you eating it!

challenges.title: Judge's Table: Maple Dessert
challenges.instructions: Order something sweet and maple. Taste it slowly. Give it your maple leaf rating.
challenges.photoPrompt: Snap a picture of you eating it!

steps.funFact: Tourtière is a meat pie that Québec families love in winter.

steps.clueRiddle:
One last drive north to the mat tonight.
Someone's race ends here — hurry.
steps.clueReveal: Drive back to Hôtel Le Dauphin. Step onto the pit stop mat.
steps.funFact: Tomorrow is the longest drive of the whole race.
